about_short_description.short_description: Stock Unlock is an investment education and analysis platform for financial education and trade analysis.

product.name: AI Reporting
product.description: Provides one-click AI-generated stock analysis for any stock to assist investment decisions.

product.name: International Stocks and ETFs
product.description: Access to over 130,000 global stocks and ETFs across 65 exchanges for comprehensive market coverage.

product.name: Portfolio Tracking
product.description: Allows users to connect their brokerage accounts to track and analyze their investment portfolios in real time.

product.name: Event Notifications
product.description: Delivers real-time alerts on portfolio changes and stock events to keep investors informed.

product.name: Watchlists
product.description: Enables users to create and manage customizable watchlists to monitor selected stocks.

product.name: Insights Score
product.description: Provides a scoring system to evaluate stocks and identify better investment opportunities.
